verdict.rationale: Guardrail docs show the Customer Agent can transfer a ticket to a human team with a summary note. Because the agent works as a team member inside Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon, the conversation history plausibly stays on the ticket the human picks up, though this is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the full conversation transcript is handed to the human, structured hand-off of collected customer details or tool results, any evidence that customers avoid repeating themselves, and independent or hands-on corroboration of escalation quality.
